CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2012 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2012 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 302 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 1 benchmark sites in 1 regions spanning 1 states (survey period: November 2012 to November 2012). These surveys captured 6 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 3 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 280 cards across 25 sites, with 1.4% showing evidence of mouse activity (4 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 24 transects across 21 sites (survey period: October 2012 to November 2012), detecting active burrows in 0% of transects (total: 0 active burrows).
